cases.purpose: Independently assert path-specific Linux errno diagnostics and failure status for EPERM, ENOENT, EINVAL and EBUSY, with seccomp blocking all swapon calls.
cases.oracle: util-linux swapon from the locked VM run on the same swap area under the same seccomp result, with its final line checked against the literal C-locale strerror message; an independent libc control checks each seccomp errno before either runs.
cases.comparison: Every diagnostic line ends with the util-linux line in the same position, the last being swapon: PATH: swapon failed: MESSAGE; empty stdout and the util-linux status; Bash location prefix permitted. The earlier expectation named a nonexistent path and a one-line form, which util-linux 2.41 never reaches: it reports that it cannot open the file.
